title: Teacher with the highest average
statementMd:
Which teacher's students score the highest on average? Show the teacher and the average rounded to 2 decimals. No tie.

Expected columns: `name`, `avg_score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT t.name, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM teachers t JOIN courses c ON c.teacher_id = t.id JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.id GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
